The Arcade DEMO

A downloadable game for Windows

Download NowName your own price

The Arcade is a PSX-style psychological horror story game set in the early 2000s.

IF YOU LIKED THIS GAME


You play as Trevor, the owner of a dying arcade struggling to keep his business alive as home consoles begin replacing arcades.

Over the course of several days, Trevor works to keep the arcade running while strange events begin to bring his forgotten past back to the surface.


Creepy visitors begin appearing.

Familiar faces return.

And a group of local thugs starts causing trouble around the arcade.

Through Trevor's memories, you'll slowly uncover the events that changed his life forever.

Features

  • Story Driven Gameplay
  • Playable arcade machines
  • Interactive NPCs.
  • PSX Style Visuals
  • Psychological Horror
  • Authentic Early 2000s Setting
  • Explore an Interactive Arcade
  • Serve Customers and Maintain the Arcade
  • Uncover Trevor's Memories
  • Strange Visitors and Encounters

Controls

 WASD - Move
 Mouse - Look Around
 E - Interact
 F - Toggle Flashlight
 ESC - Pause
 Space - Advance Dialogue

Update 1.1 Changes:

  • Fixed a bug where choosing option 2 in the Day 3 NPC argument softlocked the game
  • Removed filler from the Day 3 NPC argument dialog
  • Removed Random wear Post-Processing effect reducing noise and video compression
  • Improved the Post Processing effect quality
  • Reduced the saturation on the playable arcade machine screen to avoid dizziness and nausia when playing
  • Added extra instructions on the unplayable arcade machines to prevent getting stuck on the Wishlist screen
